definitions.explanation: The upper, arched surface of the foot, opposite the sole; the instep.

examples.japanese: {足|あし}の{甲|こう}が{痛|いた}い。
examples.english: The top of my foot hurts.

examples.japanese: {足|あし}の{甲|こう}を{日焼|ひや}けしてしまった。
examples.english: I ended up sunburning the top of my foot.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{靴|くつ}が{足|あし}の{甲|こう}に{当|あ}たって、{歩|ある}くたびに{痛|いた}い。
examples.english: The new shoes press on the top of my foot, and it hurts every time I walk.

notes:
{足|あし} (foot) + {甲|こう} (shell; upper/back surface). The arched top of the foot, contrasted with {足|あし}の{裏|うら} (the sole).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {足|あし}の{甲|こう}が{高|たか}い: to have a high instep
- {足|あし}の{甲|こう}を{痛|いた}める: to injure the top of the foot

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {手|て}の{甲|こう}: back of the hand — the same {甲|こう} used for the hand
